line: Two first-timers build a crib from a flat-pack manual, ten steps on one 45° page; step ten was never in the manual.
line_cn: 两个从没装过家具的新手照说明书装婴儿床，十步排在同一张 45° 说明书上；第十步，说明书里没有。

camera.move: Push into a parts box / object
Pan or whip along the page to the next step
camera.serves: the next step; skipping dull steps

camera.move: Tilt to the next row, the step number entering first
Locked frame on a do/don't box
Push through a shape (the ✓ cell, a magnifier circle)
camera.serves: the right way, shown big; a close-up

camera.move: Shape-matched cut (a bolt head → a round knob)
camera.serves: a mistake revealed; a time jump

camera.move: Pull back to the whole page

transitions: The camera is a 2D camera over one long sheet: pan, whip, tilt, push, pull, and cuts.
labels: On the page only step numbers (a geometric sans, e.g. Inter 700, about 150 px at 1:1, top left of each step's area, printed on the paper and moving with it) and counts in parts boxes ("4×", Inter 600). Everything else is said by drawings and the voice.

Subtitles bottom left, left-aligned: Chinese (e.g. Noto Sans SC 500, 38 px) over English (Inter 500, 32 px, ink at about 78 %), one line each, an 8 px yellow bar on the left marking the line being spoken. No box, outline or shadow; a soft paper-coloured bed (same colour as the page) keeps them readable over line art. Keep subjects out of that corner.
A title, if any, is printed on the page like a manual's cover or footer, never a title card over the picture.
motion: Parts fly along dotted guide lines in straight paths, ease in, and stop with a small settle; a beat of stillness after each one lands.
Arrow first, motion second: the arrow is drawn, then the part follows it once and holds.
The new part's yellow fades to white once it is fitted.
People move between a few key poses with eased interpolation; walking is short shuffled steps when carrying.

native_moves.name: Parts explosion
native_moves.does: The box opens and its parts fly along their own dotted lines to a counted parts list.
native_moves.fits: unboxing; a kit's contents; what a product is made of.

native_moves.name: Line art grows
native_moves.does: Floor line → object → people → arrows → magnifier, then the flat colours.
native_moves.fits: a step being built up; a scene appearing.

native_moves.name: Arrow-driven assembly
native_moves.does: A flat arrow in the isometric plane, then the part follows it and lands.

native_moves.name: New part yellow
native_moves.does: The new part is yellow, then turns white.
native_moves.fits: what changed in this step; the one new thing at the end.

native_moves.name: Magnifier circle
native_moves.does: A small ring on the spot, a leader line, a big circle redrawn at 3–4× with a hand and a rotation arrow.
native_moves.fits: tightening, pressing, a latch, a connector.

native_moves.name: Do / don't box
native_moves.does: One white rounded box split in two: red ✗ beside blue ✓, drawn as strokes.
native_moves.fits: safety rules; common mistakes; two ways to hold something.

native_moves.name: Push through a shape
native_moves.does: The camera dives into the ✓ cell or a magnifier circle and comes out in the next picture.
native_moves.fits: zooming into the right way; changing scene inside one page.

native_moves.name: The whole page
native_moves.does: A final pull back shows every step laid out on one sheet.
native_moves.fits: a summary; the full procedure at a glance.

score.note: a small tidy ensemble that counts steps
